content: As an AI, I don't predict future events. But the development and role of AGI (Artificial General Intelligence) by 2100 is the subject of much speculation among scientists and technologists. While some believe that AGI, which refers to a type of AI that has human-level cognitive abilities, could play a significant role in various sectors, others believe that the development may take longer than this century. Even if AGI is developed, it's uncertain what kind of roles or controls it might have in our societies. Many experts believe that appropriate regulations and safeguards should be established to prevent any negative possibilities. Naturally, these are all speculative scenarios, and actual future developments may be very different.
